title: Phase closeout
canonical_definition: Reconcile the complete accumulated CMP-3 node420 worker runtime against current main, run the required Level 3 qualification on one exact merge-candidate implementation SHA, preserve durable evidence, and prepare the handoff to CMP-4 — Scientific compute framework.
authority_boundaries: node420-compute remains an off-chain worker runtime and gains no canonical job, verifier, settlement, governance, wallet or bridge authority
execution-key receipts are attribution evidence rather than correctness or payment authority
result and evidence upload success is delivery evidence rather than canonical result-state authority
local resource controls and malicious-workload quarantine remain operator-local and non-authoritative
cross-platform packaging is structural build evidence and does not claim native Windows/macOS runtime qualification, signing, notarization or live deployment

ci_ownership.solidity_full_inventory: Solidity Contracts / four balanced PR shards
ci_ownership.genesis_address_authority: Genesis Address Authority / no duplicate full Foundry

non_applicable_direct_clients.420-indexer: CMP-3 adds the off-chain worker runtime and no indexer schema, ingestion, contract-discovery or event-consumer surface
non_applicable_direct_clients.420-rpc: no CMP-3 RPC API, method, schema or backend surface changed or introduced
non_applicable_direct_clients.420Search: no CMP-3 Search consumer or indexing surface changed or introduced
non_applicable_direct_clients.frontend/backend: no CMP-3 user-facing application/backend service surface is implemented in this phase; human-facing Compute UI remains CMP-8

live_blockers: public testnet worker deployment and funded-chain execution evidence remain CMP-9 scope
native Windows/macOS workload-runtime qualification remains external/native-host evidence
Apple notarization and Authenticode signing are not repository closeout claims
production GPU backend availability and live worker fleet operation remain later operational scope
